Land Acquisition Notices
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk1A – G41657– 19 (03/2024)
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I , Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotment of below mentioned land, depicted in Advance Tracing No. : KU/UDB/2001/172 and dated 04.09.2001 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in village of Heeralumulla in Yagampaththu Korale Minor Division in Udubaddawa Divisional Secretay's Division, in Kurunegala District in North Western Province and bounded as follows.

01. Lot ‘A’ – Wijerathnawaththa – Extent: 0.6056 Hectare North: Dummalasuriya - Yagamwela main Road; East: The land claimed by Edonis and yet anothers and the land claimed by Kuli/Dummalasuriya J.R. Jayawardana Central College; South and west: The land claimed by Kuli/Dummalasuriya J. R. Jayawardana Central College. Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
Land Ministry's Ref. No. : LD/05/2001/E/17.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,"Mihikatha Medura", No. 1200/6, Rajamalwaththa Road, Battaramulla.1st February, 2024

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I , Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The following Lot of land, depicted in the Advance Tracing No. : MA/AKR/2020/233 and dated 18.08.2020 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the village of Wilagama in the Grama Niladhari Division of Wilagama in Waligam Korale North Minor Division in Divisional Secretay's Division, of Akuressa in the District of Matara Southern Province as follows.

01. Lot ‘A’ – Amarasinghagevila – Extent: 0.0126 Hectare North: R.M. Disanayaka claimed by Akuressa Waththa and Pradeshiya Saba Road; East: Pradeshiya Saba Road; South: Pradeshiya Saba Road and P. D. Chandrasena claimed by Amarasinghagedeniya; West: P. D. Chandrasena claimed by Amarasinghagedeniya and R.M. Disanayaka claimed by Akuressa Waththa.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My No. : 4-3/5/2020/HA/42.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,"Mihikatha Medura", No. 1200/6, Rajamalwaththa Road, Battaramulla.30th October 2023.
